stemMd: Which particle has approximately the same mass as a proton but no electric charge?
explanationMd: Neutrons and protons are nucleons with similar masses. A neutron is electrically neutral, while a proton carries a positive elementary charge. Electrons and positrons are far lighter, and an alpha particle contains multiple nucleons.

distractorRationale.a: An electron is negatively charged and much lighter.
distractorRationale.e: A positron is positively charged and has electron-scale mass.
distractorRationale.c: An alpha particle has charge +2 and a mass of about four nucleons.
distractorRationale.d: A photon has no rest mass and is not a nucleon.
